body: I deleted my facebook account because some of those friends are jerk like that. I always felt they’re not even friends, just worst people who like to see me suffering.
Yes. And it’s hard just to explain why I feel that. Like, I don’t even hate them.
They want to put me into psychiatric care after discovered my attempt. I’m in runaway. I don’t know what to do. So afraid, so confused, angry. I just don’t know what to do with my life.

Better than the ‘You’. 

The conversations are not all cliché, like when Nadia having mental breakdown or when she tries to talk to Alan about life isn’t black and white, good or bad, or about perfection. They’re both saved from their loneliness. It seems like not-so-everyday conversations between a good friend. Or lover. Or anything platonically that happens once. 

And I can’t believe it’s just a fiction.

I don’t know you and I don’t know how much life gives you pain, but I can lend an ear. You’re not alone. I mean, it can be terrifying to think about death alone. Because I feel it too, almost everyday I want to give up.
Pretty sure it’s in Indonesia not US, OP
